registry._doc: master §17 (EXT-26–29, U18): the two market shops are FINISHED, ENTERABLE spaces whose catalogs are EMPTY by design. This registry is the minimal extensible data: a shop's id, kind, room, status and an item list that is intentionally [] — no product, price, purchase, equipped item or silhouette is invented. `states` distinguish APPROVED (owner-approved items), UNDESIGNED (the whole family until the apparel / weapon art and the fit / combat rules exist), TEST_ONLY (fixtures that must never ship) and RUNTIME (what the build actually lists). A validator (16_TESTS/gameplay_interior_entry.test.mjs) checks every listed item's asset reference exists — with zero items that check is vacuous today, and the test proves the validator rejects a synthetic bad reference.
